metadata.title: आदिवासी कैसे पकाते हैं मटन सिरी पाया । Adivasi cooking Mutton Siri and Paaya । Goat Trotters Recipe
metadata.description:
In this episode of The Tribal Kitchen we take you to a small tribal village of Madhya Pradesh. Here we cooked "Mutton Bheja and Paye" in a very unique Adivasi style.
